name: Signup completes with the mocked OTP and lands on the sign-up bonus screen
"Text me a Code" opens the OTP modal
User can switch between the Active and History tabs
Active tab shows the Entry Amount and Max Payout stats
Dedicated chevron toggle expands and collapses the card
Contest entry uses a promo selected from the Promotions tab
Resend is locked behind the cooldown after the first code
Cancel Entry countdown stays within the 5-minute window
Placing an entry logs Contest Placed and cancelling it logs Contest Canceled as the newest rows
Tailers pill reads "<n> tailers | $<reward>" when an entry has tailers
Confirming cancel twice fires the cancel request only once (double-submit guard)
First page rows mirror the balance-log API — label, date, signed amount, newest first
Wrong OTP is rejected and no account is created
Switching month reloads the log for that month
View Leaderboard on a history card opens the leaderboard modal with a working FAQ link
Pagination advances through every history page
Delete account confirms the freeze with "Your Account Has Been Frozen!" and Understood
First history card shows the amount, result and pick count from the API
Contest Settled rows credit the payout
Paging loads the next rows and keeps newest-first order across pages
Switching from 6 Months to 7 Days never increases the history count
History entry surfaces a Won / Lost / Cancelled result pill
Active card shows the entry amount, payout and Insured/All In multiplier
Entry card expands and collapses via its header button
History cards never render the pick-badge preview
Active tab shows at most one page of entry cards, or the no-data state
Empty state renders for a month with no transactions
A user behind on the Terms is gated until they accept the new version
View Leaderboard opens the contest-group leaderboard modal
Each type filter requests its category and lists only that category
Collapsed active card shows the pick-badge preview; expanding hides it
Switching the time range from the last page settles on data or the empty state
Share button opens the share-slip modal for shareable entries
Live entries surface a Live indicator
Transaction Log renders with the month and type filters
Fresh entry shows a live cancel countdown and confirming Cancel Entry removes it everywhere
History summary stats match the API for the 6 Months range
Delete account freezes the user, ends the session and refuses the next login
